info.name: Flanksource - HTTP Security Header Baseline
author: flanksource
info.description:
Enforces the Flanksource baseline for internet-facing HTTP endpoints. Unlike the
community http-missing-security-headers template this asserts header *values*, not
just presence: HSTS must be at least one year and cover subdomains, CSP must exist
and must not be trivially permissive, and nosniff must actually be set.
info.remediation:
Set the headers on the ingress-nginx ConfigMap or per-Ingress via the
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet annotation. See
specs/bases/common/nginx/nginx.yml.

info.name: Flanksource - Session Cookie Flags
author: flanksource
info.description:
Mission Control authenticates through Ory Kratos, which sets `ory_kratos_session`
and CSRF cookies. Those cookies are bearer credentials for a multi-tenant SaaS
control plane, so every Set-Cookie on these hosts must carry Secure, HttpOnly and
an explicit SameSite.
info.remediation:
Kratos cookie flags are set in the mission-control chart values
(kratos.config.session.cookie / selfservice). Do not rely on browser defaults for
SameSite — Safari and older Chrome differ.

specs/bases/common/nginx/nginx.yml.
